attempts.summary: Configured a persistent UFW host firewall on node1 (Ubuntu 16.04): SSH (22/tcp) allowed from anywhere, TCP 9000 allowed only from node2 (10.100.193.11), and TCP 9000 rejected from all other sources including node3 (10.100.193.12). Verified with live traffic tests both before and after restarting all three managed nodes one at a time, confirming rule persistence across reboot and full node recovery.
